hooks.command: FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.py ]] && [[ -f "$FILE" ]]; then uv run ruff check --fix "$FILE" 2>&1 || true; uv run ruff format "$FILE" 2>&1 || true; fi
FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"; if [[ "$FILE" == *".env"* ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *".env.example"* ]]; then echo "BLOCKED: Refusing to write to .env file: $FILE" >&2; exit 1; fi
